RESIDENTIAL STREETS PAVEMENT RECONSTRUCTION #108
bids.description: Clark County invites qualified firms or individuals to submit bids. Questions regarding this bid must be directed to the Bid Contact listed in this bid. The work to be performed under this contract consists of excavating existing pavement material, repairing base failures as needed by replacing with Type II aggregate and re-compacting the subgrade materials, and placing new 3” or 4” asphalt concrete pavement on the top on various residential streets within Clark County. In addition, this contract consists of widening existing roadway pavement in various residential rural preservation areas, removing and replacing concrete sidewalk panels, curb & gutter, and spandrels/cross gutters at locations shown on the plans, bringing sidewalk ramps up to ADA Standards, installing drainage curb & valley gutters, reconstruct multiple storm drain drop-inlet top slabs and grate openings, adjustment of manholes and water valves among other appurtenances, removing and replacing pavement markings, striping and traffic signs, traffic loops, installation of traffic conduit and other related items of work within the unincorporated area of Clark County, Nevada.

TRAFFIC SIGNAL IMPROVEMENTS AT BRUCE WOODBURY DRIVE AND NEEDLES HIGHWAY
bids.description: Clark County invites qualified firms or individuals to submit bids. Questions regarding this bid must be directed to the Bid Contact listed in this bid. The work to be performed under this Contract is for the construction of fully operational Traffic Signal System at the intersection of Bruce Woodbury Drive and Needles Highway, in Clark County, Nevada. The Work will generally consist of demolition, removal, and disposal of existing improvements and removal and salvage of designated items; miscellaneous roadway improvements including pavement rehabilitation, curb and gutter, sidewalk, medians, sidewalk ramps with tactile warning panels, pavement markings and markers, and permanent signs; valve box and manhole adjustments; intersection streetlighting; installation of traffic signal system and appurtenances; ITS improvements; traffic control; dust control; and miscellaneous improvements as shown on the Drawings.
